scene.label: Act 2, Scene 1
scene.title: SCENE I. London. A Room in the palace
scene.location: London. A Room in the palace

content.text: Enter King Edward, sick, Queen Elizabeth, Dorset, Rivers, Hastings, Buckingham, Grey and others.

lines.text: Why, so. Now have I done a good day's work.
lines.plainText: Why so Now have I done a good day's work

lines.text: You peers, continue this united league.
lines.plainText: You peers continue this united league

lines.text: I every day expect an embassage
lines.plainText: I every day expect an embassage

lines.text: From my Redeemer, to redeem me hence;
lines.plainText: From my Redeemer to redeem me hence

lines.text: And more at peace my soul shall part to heaven
lines.plainText: And more at peace my soul shall part to heaven

lines.text: Since I have made my friends at peace on earth.
lines.plainText: Since I have made my friends at peace on earth

lines.text: Rivers and Hastings, take each other's hand;
lines.plainText: Rivers and Hastings take each other's hand

lines.text: Dissemble not your hatred. Swear your love.
lines.plainText: Dissemble not your hatred Swear your love

lines.text: By heaven, my soul is purged from grudging hate,
lines.plainText: By heaven my soul is purged from grudging hate

lines.text: And with my hand I seal my true heart's love.
lines.plainText: And with my hand I seal my true heart's love

lines.text: So thrive I, as I truly swear the like.
lines.plainText: So thrive I as I truly swear the like

lines.text: Take heed you dally not before your King,
lines.plainText: Take heed you dally not before your King

lines.text: Lest He that is the supreme King of kings
lines.plainText: Lest He that is the supreme King of kings

lines.text: Confound your hidden falsehood, and award
lines.plainText: Confound your hidden falsehood and award

lines.text: Either of you to be the other's end.
lines.plainText: Either of you to be the other's end

lines.text: So prosper I, as I swear perfect love.
lines.plainText: So prosper I as I swear perfect love

lines.text: And I, as I love Hastings with my heart.
lines.plainText: And I as I love Hastings with my heart

lines.text: Madam, yourself is not exempt from this;
lines.plainText: Madam yourself is not exempt from this

lines.text: Nor you, son Dorset; Buckingham, nor you.
lines.plainText: Nor you son Dorset Buckingham nor you

lines.text: You have been factious one against the other.
lines.plainText: You have been factious one against the other

lines.text: Wife, love Lord Hastings, let him kiss your hand,
lines.plainText: Wife love Lord Hastings let him kiss your hand

lines.text: And what you do, do it unfeignedly.
lines.plainText: And what you do do it unfeignedly

lines.text: There, Hastings, I will never more remember
lines.plainText: There Hastings I will never more remember

lines.text: Our former hatred, so thrive I and mine.
lines.plainText: Our former hatred so thrive I and mine

lines.text: Dorset, embrace him; Hastings, love lord Marquess.
lines.plainText: Dorset embrace him Hastings love lord Marquess

lines.text: This interchange of love, I here protest,
lines.plainText: This interchange of love I here protest

lines.text: Upon my part shall be inviolable.
lines.plainText: Upon my part shall be inviolable

lines.text: And so swear I.
lines.plainText: And so swear I

lines.text: Now, princely Buckingham, seal thou this league
lines.plainText: Now princely Buckingham seal thou this league

lines.text: With thy embracements to my wife's allies,
lines.plainText: With thy embracements to my wife's allies

lines.text: And make me happy in your unity.
lines.plainText: And make me happy in your unity

lines.text: Whenever Buckingham doth turn his hate
lines.plainText: Whenever Buckingham doth turn his hate

lines.text: Upon your Grace, but with all duteous love
lines.plainText: Upon your Grace but with all duteous love

lines.text: Doth cherish you and yours, God punish me
lines.plainText: Doth cherish you and yours God punish me

lines.text: With hate in those where I expect most love.
lines.plainText: With hate in those where I expect most love

lines.text: When I have most need to employ a friend,
lines.plainText: When I have most need to employ a friend

lines.text: And most assured that he is a friend,
lines.plainText: And most assured that he is a friend

lines.text: Deep, hollow, treacherous, and full of guile
lines.plainText: Deep hollow treacherous and full of guile

lines.text: Be he unto me: this do I beg of God,
lines.plainText: Be he unto me this do I beg of God

lines.text: When I am cold in love to you or yours.
lines.plainText: When I am cold in love to you or yours

lines.text: A pleasing cordial, princely Buckingham,
lines.plainText: A pleasing cordial princely Buckingham

lines.text: Is this thy vow unto my sickly heart.
lines.plainText: Is this thy vow unto my sickly heart

lines.text: There wanteth now our brother Gloucester here,
lines.plainText: There wanteth now our brother Gloucester here

lines.text: To make the blessed period of this peace.
lines.plainText: To make the blessed period of this peace

lines.text: And in good time,
lines.plainText: And in good time

lines.text: Here comes Sir Ratcliffe and the Duke.
lines.plainText: Here comes Sir Ratcliffe and the Duke

lines.text: Good morrow to my sovereign King and Queen;
lines.plainText: Good morrow to my sovereign King and Queen

lines.text: And, princely peers, a happy time of day.
lines.plainText: And princely peers a happy time of day

lines.text: Happy indeed, as we have spent the day.
lines.plainText: Happy indeed as we have spent the day

lines.text: Gloucester, we have done deeds of charity,
lines.plainText: Gloucester we have done deeds of charity

lines.text: Made peace of enmity, fair love of hate,
lines.plainText: Made peace of enmity fair love of hate

lines.text: Between these swelling wrong-incensed peers.
lines.plainText: Between these swelling wrongincensed peers

lines.text: A blessed labour, my most sovereign lord,
lines.plainText: A blessed labour my most sovereign lord

lines.text: Among this princely heap, if any here
lines.plainText: Among this princely heap if any here

lines.text: By false intelligence or wrong surmise
lines.plainText: By false intelligence or wrong surmise

lines.text: Hold me a foe,
lines.plainText: Hold me a foe

lines.text: If I unwittingly, or in my rage,
lines.plainText: If I unwittingly or in my rage

lines.text: Have aught committed that is hardly borne
lines.plainText: Have aught committed that is hardly borne

lines.text: By any in this presence, I desire
lines.plainText: By any in this presence I desire

lines.text: To reconcile me to his friendly peace.
lines.plainText: To reconcile me to his friendly peace

lines.text: 'Tis death to me to be at enmity;
lines.plainText: 'Tis death to me to be at enmity

lines.text: I hate it, and desire all good men's love.
lines.plainText: I hate it and desire all good men's love

lines.text: First, madam, I entreat true peace of you,
lines.plainText: First madam I entreat true peace of you

lines.text: Which I will purchase with my duteous service;
lines.plainText: Which I will purchase with my duteous service

lines.text: Of you, my noble cousin Buckingham,
lines.plainText: Of you my noble cousin Buckingham

lines.text: If ever any grudge were lodged between us;
lines.plainText: If ever any grudge were lodged between us

lines.text: Of you and you, Lord Rivers and of Dorset,
lines.plainText: Of you and you Lord Rivers and of Dorset

lines.text: That all without desert have frowned on me;
lines.plainText: That all without desert have frowned on me

lines.text: Of you, Lord Woodville and Lord Scales;—of you,
lines.plainText: Of you Lord Woodville and Lord Scalesof you

lines.text: Dukes, earls, lords, gentlemen; indeed, of all.
lines.plainText: Dukes earls lords gentlemen indeed of all

lines.text: I do not know that Englishman alive
lines.plainText: I do not know that Englishman alive

lines.text: With whom my soul is any jot at odds
lines.plainText: With whom my soul is any jot at odds

lines.text: More than the infant that is born tonight.
lines.plainText: More than the infant that is born tonight

lines.text: I thank my God for my humility.
lines.plainText: I thank my God for my humility

lines.text: A holy day shall this be kept hereafter.
lines.plainText: A holy day shall this be kept hereafter

lines.text: I would to God all strifes were well compounded.
lines.plainText: I would to God all strifes were well compounded

lines.text: My sovereign lord, I do beseech your Highness
lines.plainText: My sovereign lord I do beseech your Highness

lines.text: To take our brother Clarence to your grace.
lines.plainText: To take our brother Clarence to your grace

lines.text: Why, madam, have I offered love for this,
lines.plainText: Why madam have I offered love for this

lines.text: To be so flouted in this royal presence?
lines.plainText: To be so flouted in this royal presence

lines.text: Who knows not that the gentle Duke is dead?
lines.plainText: Who knows not that the gentle Duke is dead

lines.text: Who knows not he is dead! Who knows he is?
lines.plainText: Who knows not he is dead Who knows he is

lines.text: All-seeing heaven, what a world is this!
lines.plainText: Allseeing heaven what a world is this

lines.text: Look I so pale, Lord Dorset, as the rest?
lines.plainText: Look I so pale Lord Dorset as the rest

lines.text: Ay, my good lord, and no man in the presence
lines.plainText: Ay my good lord and no man in the presence

lines.text: But his red colour hath forsook his cheeks.
lines.plainText: But his red colour hath forsook his cheeks

lines.text: Is Clarence dead? The order was reversed.
lines.plainText: Is Clarence dead The order was reversed

lines.text: But he, poor man, by your first order died,
lines.plainText: But he poor man by your first order died

lines.text: And that a winged Mercury did bear;
lines.plainText: And that a winged Mercury did bear

lines.text: Some tardy cripple bore the countermand,
lines.plainText: Some tardy cripple bore the countermand

lines.text: That came too lag to see him buried.
lines.plainText: That came too lag to see him buried

lines.text: God grant that some, less noble and less loyal,
lines.plainText: God grant that some less noble and less loyal

lines.text: Nearer in bloody thoughts, and not in blood,
lines.plainText: Nearer in bloody thoughts and not in blood

lines.text: Deserve not worse than wretched Clarence did,
lines.plainText: Deserve not worse than wretched Clarence did

lines.text: And yet go current from suspicion!
lines.plainText: And yet go current from suspicion

lines.text: A boon, my sovereign, for my service done!
lines.plainText: A boon my sovereign for my service done

lines.text: I prithee, peace. My soul is full of sorrow.
lines.plainText: I prithee peace My soul is full of sorrow

lines.text: I will not rise unless your Highness hear me.
lines.plainText: I will not rise unless your Highness hear me

lines.text: Then say at once what is it thou requests.
lines.plainText: Then say at once what is it thou requests

lines.text: The forfeit, sovereign, of my servant's life
lines.plainText: The forfeit sovereign of my servant's life

lines.text: Who slew today a riotous gentleman
lines.plainText: Who slew today a riotous gentleman

lines.text: Lately attendant on the Duke of Norfolk.
lines.plainText: Lately attendant on the Duke of Norfolk

lines.text: Have I a tongue to doom my brother's death,
lines.plainText: Have I a tongue to doom my brother's death

lines.text: And shall that tongue give pardon to a slave?
lines.plainText: And shall that tongue give pardon to a slave

lines.text: My brother killed no man; his fault was thought,
lines.plainText: My brother killed no man his fault was thought

lines.text: And yet his punishment was bitter death.
lines.plainText: And yet his punishment was bitter death

lines.text: Who sued to me for him? Who, in my wrath,
lines.plainText: Who sued to me for him Who in my wrath

lines.text: Kneeled at my feet, and bid me be advised?
lines.plainText: Kneeled at my feet and bid me be advised

lines.text: Who spoke of brotherhood? Who spoke of love?
lines.plainText: Who spoke of brotherhood Who spoke of love

lines.text: Who told me how the poor soul did forsake
lines.plainText: Who told me how the poor soul did forsake

lines.text: The mighty Warwick, and did fight for me?
lines.plainText: The mighty Warwick and did fight for me

lines.text: Who told me, in the field at Tewksbury,
lines.plainText: Who told me in the field at Tewksbury

lines.text: When Oxford had me down, he rescued me,
lines.plainText: When Oxford had me down he rescued me

lines.text: And said, "Dear brother, live, and be a king"?
lines.plainText: And said Dear brother live and be a king

lines.text: Who told me, when we both lay in the field
lines.plainText: Who told me when we both lay in the field

lines.text: Frozen almost to death, how he did lap me
lines.plainText: Frozen almost to death how he did lap me

lines.text: Even in his garments, and did give himself,
lines.plainText: Even in his garments and did give himself

lines.text: All thin and naked, to the numb-cold night?
lines.plainText: All thin and naked to the numbcold night

lines.text: All this from my remembrance brutish wrath
lines.plainText: All this from my remembrance brutish wrath

lines.text: Sinfully plucked, and not a man of you
lines.plainText: Sinfully plucked and not a man of you

lines.text: Had so much grace to put it in my mind.
lines.plainText: Had so much grace to put it in my mind

lines.text: But when your carters or your waiting vassals
lines.plainText: But when your carters or your waiting vassals

lines.text: Have done a drunken slaughter, and defaced
lines.plainText: Have done a drunken slaughter and defaced

lines.text: The precious image of our dear Redeemer,
lines.plainText: The precious image of our dear Redeemer

lines.text: You straight are on your knees for pardon, pardon,
lines.plainText: You straight are on your knees for pardon pardon

lines.text: And I, unjustly too, must grant it you.
lines.plainText: And I unjustly too must grant it you

lines.text: But for my brother not a man would speak,
lines.plainText: But for my brother not a man would speak

lines.text: Nor I, ungracious, speak unto myself
lines.plainText: Nor I ungracious speak unto myself

lines.text: For him, poor soul. The proudest of you all
lines.plainText: For him poor soul The proudest of you all

lines.text: Have been beholding to him in his life,
lines.plainText: Have been beholding to him in his life

lines.text: Yet none of you would once beg for his life.
lines.plainText: Yet none of you would once beg for his life

lines.text: O God, I fear Thy justice will take hold
lines.plainText: O God I fear Thy justice will take hold

lines.text: On me, and you, and mine and yours for this!
lines.plainText: On me and you and mine and yours for this

lines.text: Come, Hastings, help me to my closet.
lines.plainText: Come Hastings help me to my closet

lines.text: Ah, poor Clarence!
lines.plainText: Ah poor Clarence

lines.text: This is the fruit of rashness. Marked you not
lines.plainText: This is the fruit of rashness Marked you not

lines.text: How that the guilty kindred of the Queen
lines.plainText: How that the guilty kindred of the Queen

lines.text: Looked pale when they did hear of Clarence' death?
lines.plainText: Looked pale when they did hear of Clarence' death

lines.text: O, they did urge it still unto the King.
lines.plainText: O they did urge it still unto the King

lines.text: God will revenge it. Come, lords, will you go
lines.plainText: God will revenge it Come lords will you go

lines.text: To comfort Edward with our company?
lines.plainText: To comfort Edward with our company

lines.text: We wait upon your Grace.
lines.plainText: We wait upon your Grace
